page_title: Tale: Project Workspace for Teams and AI Agents

sources.entry: Tale - Open-source project workspace where teams assign tasks to AI agents in persistent sandboxes and review their reports and deliverables together. #free #opensource

summary.name: Tale
summary.one_liner: Tale is an open-source project workspace where teams plan work, delegate tasks to AI agents running in persistent sandboxes, and review the agents' deliverables together.
use_cases: assign tasks to ai agents and review their output
plan a project with teammates and agents
run parallel agent work in isolated sandboxes
self-host a team workspace for ai agents
connect agents to existing tools like github and slack
summary.what_it_does:
Tale lets a team bring tasks, files, and conversations into a project and assign each item to a person or an agent, then follow progress on a board. Agents receive instructions and tools and do their work in persistent sandboxes, where the resulting files can be inspected. The page says it supports several agent runtimes (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw, Pi, OpenCode), used with the user's own subscription or API-billed models. It can be self-hosted or run as managed hosting, with members, roles, SSO, budgets, guardrails, audit records, and run history. Connectors are listed for services such as GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Atlassian, and Shopify.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">unknown
